# Consumer Adoption Review

Copy this blank worksheet into the consumer project. Fill it from inspected project state. Do not prefill a successful outcome or infer adoption from installed components.

## Rule evidence

For every cell, choose `compatible`, `missing`, `conflicting`, or `uncertain`; cite project-relative paths with headings or line locators; explain the semantic rationale; and identify why the guidance applies to the selected feature work.

| Rule | Governance status and evidence | Active agent guidance status, evidence, and applicability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| M1 — One mutable change set before integration |  |  |
| M2 — Flow accepted changes back and reconcile before proceeding |  |  |
| M3 — Flag gaps/divergence and recommend operator-invoked checks |  |  |
| M4 — Freeze feature meaning at the designated integration boundary |  |  |
| M5 — Use a new feature for later behavior changes and retain references |  |  |

The table is the **governance evidence** and **active agent guidance evidence** matrix. Applicability belongs in the active-guidance cell; include a **guidance applicability** rationale for every cited instruction.
